economy.summary: Her campaign says everything is more expensive these days, listing eggs, coffee, and utilities, and proposes lowering costs, raising the minimum wage, and restoring skilled trade jobs.
economy.short: Proposes lowering costs, raising minimum wage, restoring trade jobs.

abortion.summary: Her campaign says she is dedicated to protecting reproductive freedom, stating that state and local governments are the frontlines to defending reproductive freedom.
abortion.short: Says she is dedicated to protecting reproductive freedom.

education.summary: Her campaign supports fair education funding so that every child receives access to the resources of a great education, no matter their zip code.
education.short: Supports fair education funding regardless of a child's zip code.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign says no one should have to drain their bank account or go into debt to be seen by a doctor, and pledges to reduce the price of prescription drugs.
healthcare.short: Pledges to reduce doctor costs and prescription drug prices.

economy.summary: His campaign says he is fighting to cut wasteful spending policies that have increased costs for families.
economy.short: Says he is fighting to cut wasteful spending that raised costs.

taxes.summary: His campaign says he passed fiscally responsible budgets that did not increase taxes on families and seniors on fixed incomes.
taxes.short: Says he passed budgets without raising taxes on families, seniors.

education.summary: His campaign says he secured record funding for children's education without raising taxes.
education.short: Says he secured record education funding without raising taxes.

energy.summary: His campaign describes him as recognized as the leading voice for lowering electricity costs for Pennsylvania ratepayers.
energy.short: Describes himself as leading voice for lowering electricity costs.

guns.summary: His campaign says he secured over $13 million to hire additional prosecutors in Delaware and Philadelphia counties, resulting in over 100 convictions of felons in possession of firearms in federal court; this entry describes a law-enforcement and prosecution platform rather than firearm regulation.
guns.short: Secured funding for prosecutors convicting felons possessing firearms.

abortion.summary: In his 2024 attorney general campaign he said he does not believe the state constitution guarantees a right to abortion access, arguing that decision belongs to the legislature, and that as attorney general he would defend the constitution regarding the Abortion Control Act.
abortion.short: Says state constitution does not guarantee a right to abortion.
